children: MACQUARIE BANK ADMITTED FAILURES IN THE WAY IT PROMOTED ITS WELCOME RATE OFFER FOR NEW SAVINGS ACCOUNT CUSTOMERS
MACQUARIE HAS ADMITTED CONTRAVENTION OF THE CORPORATIONS ACT 2001, WITH PARTIES JOINTLY PROPOSING A$14 MILLION PENALTY TO THE COURT
PROPOSED PENALTY COMES IN ADDITION TO A$8.8 MILLION IN REMEDIATION INITIATED BY MACQUARIE
MACQUARIE ADMITTED IT FAILED TO TAKE NECESSARY STEPS TO ENSURE STATEMENTS ABOUT WELCOME RATE WERE CLEAR, OTHERS
